d:
Donald tranp ke dusre rashtrapti karyakal ke pahle sal ka sinemaee safar. dar, ummid, virodh, vafadari aur nirasha- uthal-puthal se jujhte amerika ki is tasvir ko aakar dete hain.
Voshingtan DC aur vest varjiniya ka pidmont. tranp ke dusre karyakal se libral kaipital men dar aur bechaini hai, jabki eplachiya men kol kantri ko lanbe intzar ke bad aarthik sudhar ki ummid hai.
